sections.Profile:
The "Heat Wave" pinball machine, released by Williams Manufacturing Company in 1964, is a single-player, electro-mechanical game designed by Steve Kordek, with artwork by Roy Parker.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1964
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Backbox Gimmick, Swimming, Weather, Beach, Single level playfield

- Animation: Steve Kordek
- Design: Steve Kordek
- Mechanics: Steve Kordek
- Concept: Steve Kordek
- Art: Art Stenholm
